metric: Existing D26 MASE, series-level, adjacent-week full-history scale, existing leading-zero padding; constant histories excluded and counted
primary_score_aggregation: Equal mean over the original four periods; paired candidate versus incumbent within each period
meta_training_rule: Training/calibration label window at offset W must satisfy W >= test_offset + 13; fit hyperparameters only inside these earlier windows
overlapping_window_policy: Additional offsets 0,4,...,48 are development data, not independent samples. Forward check targets are nonoverlapping, but these historical periods were used by other workstreams.
forecast_version_policy: Use original source on four primary periods. Use additional source on additional periods, comparing candidate against a baseline recomposed from exactly those same files. Never substitute regenerated Chronos predictions for the pinned incumbent.
older_stress_policy: Do not score until candidate settings are frozen. Required base forecasts are missing. This older period is a backward regime stress check, not untouched prospective future confirmation.

excluded_confirmation_offsets.52: Overlaps already examined offset-48 target weeks
excluded_confirmation_offsets.78: Current own-shop early-stopping recipe has only one purged training origin; weak temporal training coverage

candidate_budget: One prespecified feature-group ablation first, same original ensemble weights and processing; no broad search or outer-fold weight tuning

promotion_review.late_horizon_guardrail: Report weeks 8-13 separately and require no mean regression versus matched incumbent
promotion_review.independent_validation_claim: Not permitted from reused periods; require new outcomes or explicit independent data

group_guardrails: Report recent activations, rare sellers, inactive products, and stock states. Error-based product IDs are diagnostics only, never hand-picked correction rules.
cross_shop_policy: No generalization claim until evaluated on A-D with feasible time cuts and shop-held-out model selection. D must report constant-history exclusions and scored unit coverage.
